text:
Dear Ms Steiner,

I'm sorry this comes so late. I meant to write in July, then my mother fell ill and everything else went out of my head for a couple of months. I hope it's not too late to put in a claim.

Let me say first that there was never any rush on my side. Nothing happened that forced me to act before I could hear from you, there was no danger of anything getting worse, so I've simply left things as they were until I could deal with it properly.

What happened is this: on Monday 20 July 2026 my laptop and my e-reader were stolen, together worth about CHF 3,600. This wasn't at home in my flat at Sonnenweg 95 in Chur. I was in Zürich that day for a work meeting, and that's where it happened.

My colleague Mark Brunner, who was with me, told me I should still contact you, since I've had my household insurance with CSS for years. I honestly don't know whether something like this is covered at all, so I'd be grateful if you could tell me how it works and what you'd need from me.

Kind regards,
Hannah Shaw
